Title: R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)

Lore:
<blockquote>A small-bodied droid brimming with energy, loyal to his master and brave. A Rebel spy who is strong in adversity. Though 3PO derided him as a “cold-hearted philosopher,” his personality is rather the opposite. He is somewhat restless and sometimes acts unexpectedly.</blockquote>

Card text:
<blockquote>Adds +2 to the power, maneuver and hyperspeed of the starfighter he is aboard (+3 if Red 5). When he is at a place with an access link and the opponent draws destiny, activate 1 Force if it is 1–3. If it is 4–6, draw the top card of the Reserve Deck and add it to your hand.</blockquote>

=== Comparison with the English printing ===
The Japanese lore says that 3PO derided R2-D2 as a “cold-hearted philosopher”; the English face instead calls R2-D2 the “Incorrigible counterpart of a mindless philosopher.” The Japanese game text uses アクセス・リンク (access link) for the English Scomp link and states the two results directly, without words corresponding to the English “you may.” It expressly adds the drawn Reserve Deck card to the hand. The printed numerical statistics match the inspected English face. Neither inspected face prints a Nav Computer symbol; a later rule-derived capability must not be presented as a printed icon.<ref name="encyclopedia-face-172">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The comparison uses the [[:File:ANH-L-r2d2.gif|original English card face]].

|extra_sections=<h2>Statistics</h2>
The printed values and symbols are shown above. The face prints one Droid symbol and the subtype 操縦ドロイド (astromech droid). It has no printed ability number and no printed Nav Computer, Pilot or Warrior symbol. Its lore identifies a Rebel spy.<ref name="encyclopedia-face-172">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Base landspeed is 1 under the character movement rule; this is a rule-derived value, not a printed statistic.<ref name="character-landspeed">[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0#Landspeed|Rulebook 2.0, Landspeed]]: “Characters have landspeed of 1.”</ref>

The 1998 Glossary states that astromech droids provide nav computers. This is a rule-derived capability, separate from the absence of a printed Nav Computer symbol on this face.<ref name="astromech-rules">[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary (1998)]], pp. 15 and 94, “astromech” and “nav computer icon”.</ref> The same Glossary gives droids no ability and gives droids without armor a defense value of zero.<ref name="droid-rules">[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary (1998)]], p. 52, “droid”.</ref>
